liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): Reviewer counts Scarlet as a highlight of the show; Phil's bass bombs during Scarlet stand out on the remaster [15][21]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Reviewer counts Estimated as a highlight; Bobby pushes a tired-sounding Jerry hard during the solo [15]
- **Little Red Rooster** (1 review): Reviewer arrived late and caught Little Red Rooster as the opening song they heard [16]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd83-03-26 01 Jack Straw**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd83-03-26 02 Friend Of The Devil**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd83-03-26 03 Little Red Rooster**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd83-03-26 04 Brown Eyed Women**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd83-03-26 05 Mama Tried**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd83-03-26 06 Mexicali Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd83-03-26 07 Althea**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd83-03-26 08 My Brother Esau**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1983-03-26.140315.sbd.eaton.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 155 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd83-03-26.neumann.dodd.11260.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 153 min; rated 3.92/5 by 12 [2]. Said about its sound: Crisp-sounding audience tape; reviewer wore out an old copy and welcomes a fresh transfer; Audience recording has too much crowd noise, though the setlist makes it worth hearing; Crowd presence is balanced and never intrudes on the music, which sounds crisp, captured at a sweet spot [11][12][13][14][15]
- **gd1983-03-26.157658.senn421.blend.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 154 min [3]
- **gd1983-03-26.fob.neumann.miller.81092.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 153 min; rated 2.89/5 by 9 [6]. Said about its sound: Remastered version sounds far better than the show did on the day; reviewer calls it a revelation [21]

## Around the show

- Attendee drove from Colorado, saw Tempe, then drove overnight; got free tickets in the parking lot and arrived during Little Red Rooster [16]
- Attendee missed Tempe because of flight trouble, arrived in Vegas the night before and wandered the Strip with prism glasses [17]
- Reviewer's group flew from Buffalo, met in Oakland, and drove overnight to Las Vegas, seeing a sunrise on arrival [20]
- Scene outside the Aladdin was wild, with blotter handed out, boiling heat, and an underground-feeling venue [22]
- People with tattooed snakes on their faces wandered the casino during the show [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1983-03-26.140315.sbd.eaton.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Charlie Miller, Scott Clugston; source: Master Soundboard Cassette -> Technics Reel to Reel -> Panasonic SV-3800 Dat 16/48 [1]. Also: Soundboard from a DAT from Rob Eaton, transferred by Charlie Miller; first soundboard in circulation for this date, December 2017; Neumann KM54 audience source, shnid 81092, supplies some crowd sound for the mix [1]
- **gd83-03-26.neumann.dodd.11260.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD>MC>DAT>CDR KM 54Âs [2]
- **gd1983-03-26.157658.senn421.blend.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Jim Vita's Master Audience Cassettes; 3 x Sennheiser 421 mics > unknown mixer > Sony D5M (Maxell XLII-S) [3]. Also: Built from first-generation cassettes from Jim Vita, transferred by Charlie Miller, with pitch correction help from Joe B. Jones; Jim Wise's Sennheiser 421 source patches six seconds in Eyes Of The World and 5:24 in Drums [3]
- **gd1983-03-26.fob.neumann.miller.81092.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Neumann KM54 -> Cassette [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1983-03-26 Ticket - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1983-03-26-ticket/) [24]
